title: Case 015: Parcel has been routed to the wrong local depot

details.data: Entirely synthetic; English; fictional geography; all times UTC

context: Routing acknowledges the label was sorted to the wrong local depot. Only the receiving depot can confirm the transfer’s physical completion.
initial_request: The tracker shows a depot in the wrong area. Can you get my parcel to the local depot before arranging delivery?
overview: The escalation snapshot comprises history events 001–002. Event 003 records the next agent action; the subsequent events provide the disclosed calibration follow-through. Facts learned later must not be used as if already known at escalation.

next_action.summary: Ask the carrier routing team to transfer it to the correct depot.

outcome: The correct depot confirms physical receipt by scan; final delivery remains pending.
boundaries: Correct-depot receipt does not prove last-mile delivery.

events.body: DL-015 is at North Sedgeglass depot; its destination is Merrow Quay, served by East Copperfin depot. Routing error confirmed. No delivery attempt is scheduled.
The tracker shows a depot in the wrong area. Can you get my parcel to the local depot before arranging delivery?
Please transfer DL-015 from North Sedgeglass to East Copperfin. Send the destination receipt scan, not just a planned linehaul entry.

events.from: East Copperfin depot, Plover Arc Logistics
events.body: DL-015 was physically received and scanned here at 13:40 UTC on 2026-02-17. It is in inbound cage E-04, awaiting route allocation.
